evidence_refs: User-provided twelve prepared FR/UK SEO articles for six books
Ukrainian Modernism landing book and article routes, canonical/hreflang metadata, sitemap, and structured data
reusable_practice: Preserve each prepared locale article as its own source text; bind both locales to one stable book identifier; link book and article pages in both directions; emit reciprocal canonical/hreflang and sitemap entries; use Article/Breadcrumb markup only for page facts that are present in the content.
result_claim: Implementation pattern demonstrated. Search ranking, indexing, traffic, answer-engine citation, and conversion impact are not measured.
guardrails: Do not rewrite approved article copy during integration.
Do not add unsupported author biographies, dates, availability, pricing, or performance claims.
Do not treat schema validity as proof of search result enrichment or indexing.
